cases.label: wide-late31-CM-opening
cases.purpose: Last output rho changes while Auth array digest stays fixed; tests last-slot CM/list binding without changing values.

cases.label: wide-late31-duplicate-coherent-digest
cases.purpose: Slots0/31 become identical with equal original values and a recomputed list digest; isolates all-slot distinctness.

cases.label: wide-u64-overflow-coherent-digest
cases.purpose: All32 values are individually legal and CMs remain distinct; exact sum exceeds u64 and input/reserve, with coherent digest.

cases.label: wide-ordered-list-swap
cases.purpose: Distinct equal-value outputs30/31 swap while original ordered digest remains; binds physical order.

cases.label: compact-terminal-rho
cases.purpose: Nonzero private rho under unchanged terminal zero sentinels must fail, despite no output CM being appended.

cases.label: compact-terminal-cipher-not-empty-hash
cases.purpose: Terminal binds SHA256(528 zero bytes), never SHA256(empty).

cases.label: compact-reserved-byte
cases.purpose: Directly retained reserved-byte witness must be zero, not merely normalized by host serialization.

cases.label: compact-alignment
cases.purpose: Old cursor1 requires aligned start2; the in-range nonmultiple3 must fail.

cases.label: compact-wrong-role-mode32
cases.purpose: Compact matrix cannot be promoted to wide by the Auth mode, preserving all other compact data.

cases.label: compact-wrong-prior-CM-root
cases.purpose: Real-note membership must authenticate the exact prior root.

cases.label: compact-wrong-real-NF
cases.purpose: The actual-slot real HMAC NF is independently constrained, not accepted from Auth.

cases.label: compact-private-output-plus-payout-inflation
cases.purpose: Public reserve/fee/payout equation remains balanced and SPK is valid; private outputs unchanged make private conservation fail.

cases.label: compact-input-sum-exceeds-reserve
cases.purpose: Private input/output/fee equation unchanged; public reserve equation balanced but owned input sum exceeds reserve.

cases.label: compact-next-CM-root-is-native-obligation
cases.purpose: Private relation deliberately does not authenticate the continuing tree append; native public path/root checks remain mandatory.
